name: External Policy Enforcement
description: Enforce security policy outside the model so generated text cannot self-authorize privileged actions.

name: Instruction / Data Separation
description: Preserve provenance and trust boundaries between control instructions and untrusted content.

name: Tool Capability Allowlist
description: Allow only explicitly approved tools and capabilities for an agent identity.

name: Contextual Tool Authorization
description: Evaluate identity, requested capability, resource and context before each tool action.

name: Human Checkpoint for High-Impact Actions
description: Require explicit approval before high-impact or irreversible actions.

name: Memory Provenance and Scope
description: Track source, scope, expiry and review state for persistent agent memory.

name: RAG Source Provenance
description: Record trust and origin of retrieved documents and preserve that metadata through inference.

name: Untrusted Output Handling
description: Encode, validate or sanitize model output before downstream interpretation or rendering.

name: AI Egress Policy
description: Restrict and monitor network access to model providers and AI gateways by workload identity.

name: AI Asset and Service Inventory
description: Maintain inventory of models, runtimes, agents, gateways, MCP servers and external providers.

name: Artifact Digest Pinning
description: Pin model, package and deployment artifacts to approved immutable digests.

name: Artifact Signature Verification
description: Verify trusted publisher identity and artifact integrity before promotion or execution.

name: Dependency Admission Policy
description: Require provenance, approved registries and review before dependencies suggested by automation are installed.

name: MCP Token Audience Validation
description: Validate that access tokens were issued for the MCP server receiving them; prohibit token passthrough.

name: MCP Explicit User Consent
description: Require clear user consent before connecting servers or invoking consequential tools.

name: MCP State Handle Binding
description: Bind server-side state handles to verified identities and re-authorize every use.

name: AI/ML Bill of Materials
description: Track models, datasets, configurations and dependencies using AI/ML-BOM-capable formats.

name: Secret Isolation
description: Keep model/provider credentials outside prompts and minimize which agents can access them.

name: Agent Action and Resource Budgets
description: Apply hard limits to iterations, tool calls, tokens, time and cost.

name: Agent Decision and Action Telemetry
description: Log identity, plan step, capability request, authorization result and side effect for agent actions.

name: Input/Output Injection & Policy Classifier
description: Run a dedicated classifier/guard model (and heuristics such as perplexity) on untrusted inputs and on model outputs/tool calls; log verdicts; never rely on it as sole control (defence-in-depth, measure false-positive/over-defence).

name: Privileged-Context Canary Tokens
description: Insert unique per-session canaries into system prompts/secret-bearing context and alert when they appear in output, tool arguments or egress (pairs with DET-AI-010).

name: Privileged / Quarantined LLM Separation
description: Planner model with tool access only sees trusted instructions; untrusted content is processed by a tool-less model returning schema-typed values that cannot alter control flow.

name: Data-Flow Provenance and Taint Policy
description: Attach source/reader capability tags to all data, propagate through derivations, and deny side-effecting tool calls whose arguments depend on untrusted or non-shareable data unless an explicit policy allows it (default deny).

name: Task-Alignment Verification of Agent Actions
description: Verify each planned tool call contributes to the user-stated goal (Task Shield) or remains stable when untrusted context is masked/re-executed (MELON) or cross-checked by an independent model.

name: Untrusted Input Transformation and Spotlighting
description: Mark/encode untrusted content (spotlighting, datamarking, random delimiters) and optionally paraphrase/retokenize/normalise (Unicode, invisible chars) before inference.

name: Typed / Templated Model Output
description: Constrain model output to schemas/enums/templates validated by deterministic code before use (complements CTRL-OUTPUT-SANITIZATION).

name: Model Injection-Robustness Selection and Evaluation
description: Select/finetune models with instruction-hierarchy or injection-resistant training and re-evaluate with adversarial suites (e.g., AgentDojo-style) on each model/version change.

name: Tool Definition Pinning
description: Hash each approved tool's name, description and input schema; block or re-prompt for consent when any of them changes after approval.

name: AI Service Exposure Management
description: Inventory model servers, agent builders, vector stores and MCP endpoints, require authentication on every one and scan the external perimeter for them.

name: Pre-filled Prompt and Memory Write Policy
description: Treat prompts arriving through URL parameters as untrusted, show them to the user before sending, and require confirmation before any memory write they request.

name: Script and Unknown Binary Execution Policy
description: Restrict execution of unsigned or unknown scripts and binaries from user-writable paths, so attacker tooling is stopped by behavior and provenance regardless of how it was written.
